description: This file contains the definition of the ConsistencyTestHarness class, which implements a testing framework for transaction consistency in Orleans-based distributed systems. It manages transaction sequences, checks for serializability violations, and reports inconsistencies.

classes.name: ConsistencyTestHarness
classes.description: A class providing methods to simulate transaction sequences and verify their consistency within an Orleans distributed system.

methods.name: ConsistencyTestHarness
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test harness with configuration options and dependencies.

methods.name: RunRandomTransactionSequence
methods.description: Executes a sequence of random transactions across grains, recording successes, failures, and exceptions.

methods.name: CheckConsistency
methods.description: Analyzes the recorded transaction history to verify serializability, detect cycles, and report violations or anomalies.
